new.title: Step inside Atatürk's Çankaya Mansion
new.desc: The Çankaya Mansion was given to Mustafa Kemal Atatürk in 1921 and served as his residence and office until 1932. It became a museum in 1950 and its dining room, study, library and bedroom are preserved. It stands inside the Presidential Çankaya compound.
new.tip: Visits are by prior arrangement through the Presidency and entry rules (gates, ID, days) change, so confirm before going.
new.q: Atatürk Müze Köşkü, Çankaya Köşkü, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: See Ankara from the top of Atakule
new.desc: Atakule is a 125 m tower topped by a globe-shaped viewing platform, built in 1989 beside Botanik Park. A mall at its base reopened in 2018 after a rebuild. Sevilla, a revolving restaurant, turns once an hour near the top.
new.tip: Go near sunset for views over Çankaya and Kızılay; the viewing terrace is reached by lift from inside the mall.
new.q: Atakule, Çankaya Caddesi, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Stroll through Botanik Park below Atakule
new.desc: Botanik Park is a landscaped park in Çankaya lying directly below Atakule, with ponds, shaded paths and play areas. It is one of the quieter green spaces in the city centre.
new.tip: Combine it with a visit to Atakule; late afternoon is the pleasant time in summer.
new.q: Botanik Parkı, Çankaya Caddesi, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Watch the swans at Kuğulu Park
new.desc: Kuğulu Park (Swan Park) dates from 1958 and is a one-hectare park with a pond where swans have lived for decades. It sits at the heart of Kavaklıdere, surrounded by cafés and embassies.
new.tip: Bring bread-free expectations: feeding is discouraged. Evenings and weekends are busiest.
new.q: Kuğulu Park, Tunalı Hilmi Caddesi, Kavaklıdere, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Relax in Seğmenler Park
new.desc: Seğmenler Park opened in 1983 between Atatürk Boulevard and İran Street, with an amphitheatre, ponds and wide lawns. Locals use it as a green lung between Kavaklıdere and Çankaya.
new.tip: Weekday mornings are calm; the amphitheatre hosts occasional open-air events.
new.q: Seğmenler Parkı, Kavaklıdere, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Explore the METU Science and Technology Museum
new.desc: Opened in 2003 on the METU campus, the museum has a silo-shaped main hall and a garden holding eight aircraft and a steam locomotive. A hangar shows classic vehicles and exhibits on Turkish technology history.
new.tip: Check opening hours and any entry fee before visiting; the campus gate may require ID.
new.q: ODTÜ Bilim ve Teknoloji Müzesi, Orta Doğu Teknik Üniversitesi, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Meet the Anatolian panther at the MTA Natural History Museum
new.desc: Founded in 1968 within the MTA General Directorate, this is Turkey's first national natural history museum. Its dioramas include extinct and endangered species and the Anatolian panther found near Beypazarı in 1974. Paleontology and mineral collections add to the displays.
new.tip: Closed on weekends in some years, so check hours; it sits on the MTA campus off Dumlupınar Boulevard.
new.q: MTA Şehit Cuma Dağ Tabiat Tarihi Müzesi, Dumlupınar Bulvarı, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Visit CerModern in the old railway workshops
new.desc: CerModern is Ankara's contemporary art centre in former railway maintenance sheds near Sıhhiye. It hosts exhibitions, a cinema space and events in the restored industrial halls.
new.tip: Free entry to most exhibitions; the Sıhhiye metro station is a short walk away.
new.q: CerModern, Altındağ Cd, Sıhhiye, Ankara

new.title: See the giant Kocatepe Mosque
new.desc: Kocatepe Mosque is Ankara's largest mosque, built between 1967 and 1987 in a style inspired by classical Ottoman mosques. Its four minarets and big dome dominate the Kızılay skyline, and an underground shopping level sits beneath it.
new.tip: Dress modestly and avoid prayer times; the courtyard is open all day.
new.q: Kocatepe Camii, Kocatepe, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Catch an exhibition at Çankaya Contemporary Arts Centre
new.desc: The Çankaya Çağdaş Sanatlar Merkezi (ÇSM) is a municipal arts venue with a concert hall, galleries and a theatre stage. It programs music, exhibitions and film in the Çankaya district.
new.tip: Check the Çankaya Municipality programme online; many events are free or low-cost.
new.q: Çankaya Çağdaş Sanatlar Merkezi, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Walk the METU campus and its forest edge
new.desc: Middle East Technical University's campus, opened in the late 1950s, mixes modernist architecture with planted pine forest and views across to Eymir. It is the first technical university campus in Turkey.
new.tip: Cars need a gate pass but pedestrians usually can walk in; the campus lake is a quiet spot.
new.q: Orta Doğu Teknik Üniversitesi, Üniversiteler Mahallesi, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Take in Lake Eymir from the shore path
new.desc: Lake Eymir lies about 20 km south of central Ankara in Gölbaşı, inside METU-managed forest land with reeds, birdlife and wooded hills. Access is restricted to keep the lake protected.
new.tip: Entry is controlled by METU; go early in the morning for birdwatching and fewer people.
new.q: Eymir Gölü, ODTÜ Ormanı, Gölbaşı, Ankara

new.title: See Mogan Lake at Gölbaşı
new.desc: Mogan Lake is a shallow freshwater lake in Gölbaşı, a protected wetland with reed beds and migrating birds. Parks and a shoreline walking route make it a popular escape from the city.
new.tip: Sunset is the best time; look for ducks and herons along the reeds.
new.q: Mogan Gölü, Gölbaşı, Ankara

new.title: Wander Altınpark's lakes and flower beds
new.desc: Altınpark was a golf course until 1977 and became a public park in 1985, covering 64 hectares with an artificial lake, gardens, a pool and walking trails. It is one of Ankara's biggest green spaces.
new.tip: Take the Altınpark metro stop; evenings bring crowds, mornings are calm.
new.q: Altınpark, Altındağ, Ankara

new.title: Walk through Bilkent University's campus
new.desc: Bilkent University, founded in 1984 by İhsan Doğramacı, has a large green campus with modern architecture, sculptures and a lake. It also houses the Bilkent Center and a concert hall.
new.tip: Pedestrians can usually enter; the metro Bilkent stop is a bus ride away.
new.q: Bilkent Üniversitesi, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: See Bilkent Center and its landmark towers
new.desc: Bilkent Center is a business and shopping complex built in the 1990s next to Bilkent University. It is a landmark of Ankara's south-western expansion.
new.tip: Combine it with Bilkent campus; plenty of cafés for a stop.
new.q: Bilkent Center, Üniversiteler Mahallesi, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Cruise Tunalı Hilmi Caddesi
new.desc: Tunalı Hilmi is Kavaklıdere's main avenue, lined with shops, cafés and bars running up to Kuğulu Park. It has been Ankara's smart promenade since the 1960s.
new.tip: Evenings and weekends are the liveliest; cafés spill onto the pavement.
new.q: Tunalı Hilmi Caddesi, Kavaklıdere, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Glimpse the Wonderland Ankara coasters
new.desc: Wonderland Ankara (Harikalar Diyarı) is an amusement park that opened in 2004 in Sincan, with rides, a water park and a Ferris wheel. It is one of Turkey's larger theme parks.
new.tip: Check seasonal opening; weekdays are quieter.
new.q: Harikalar Diyarı, Sincan, Ankara

new.title: Relax at Ahlatlıbel Atatürk Park
new.desc: Ahlatlıbel Atatürk Park is a large Çankaya green space towards İncek, with picnic lawns and walking paths. It offers a quieter alternative to central parks.
new.tip: Bring a picnic; weekends are busiest.
new.q: Ahlatlıbel Atatürk Parkı, İncek, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Follow Dikmen Valley from Dikmen to Ayrancı
new.desc: Dikmen Valley is a landscaped dry stream bed between Dikmen and Ayrancı, redeveloped from 1996 into a chain of parks, ponds and promenades. It links several neighbourhoods on foot.
new.tip: Start at the Dikmen end and walk down; cafés and playgrounds line the way.
new.q: Dikmen Vadisi, Dikmen, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Sip coffee at Café des Cafés on Tunalı Hilmi
new.desc: Café des Cafés is a long-running café on Tunalı Hilmi Caddesi with vintage décor, sofas and a pavement terrace. It has long been a favourite for coffee and cake in Kavaklıdere.
new.tip: Try the desserts with Turkish coffee; arrive early at weekends.
new.q: Café des Cafés, Tunalı Hilmi Caddesi 83/A, Kavaklıdere, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Dine at Niki in a villa garden
new.desc: Niki is a Gaziosmanpaşa restaurant in an old villa with a garden, serving contemporary Mediterranean dishes. It is a long-standing choice for special evenings in GOP.
new.tip: Book a garden table in summer.
new.q: Niki Restaurant, Gaziosmanpaşa, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Eat fresh fish at Trilye in GOP
new.desc: Trilye is a seafood restaurant in Gaziosmanpaşa with a large enclosed garden, known as one of Ankara's better fish tables. The menu follows the market catch and Aegean mezes.
new.tip: Ask for the day's fish and a few cold mezes.
new.q: Trilye Restoran, Gaziosmanpaşa, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Try seasonal Mediterranean at La Gioia
new.desc: La Gioia is a Mediterranean restaurant on Çayhane Sokak in Gaziosmanpaşa with a menu that follows the seasons. It is a quieter option for dinner in GOP.
new.tip: Reserve for weekends.
new.q: La Gioia, Çayhane Sokak, Gaziosmanpaşa, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Order tava at Meşhur Tavacı Recep Usta
new.desc: Tavacı Recep Usta is a well-known Ankara restaurant serving traditional Anatolian dishes, famous for its tava (pan-fried meat) and wood-oven plates. Reviews praise service but note higher prices.
new.tip: Order the tava and share a mezze plate.
new.q: Meşhur Tavacı Recep Usta, Bestekar Sokak, Kavaklıdere, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Dine at the Sevilla revolving restaurant in Atakule
new.desc: Sevilla sits at the top of Atakule and rotates through 360 degrees every hour, offering city views with dinner. Entry to the viewing terrace is free when you book a table.
new.tip: Reserve a window table before sunset.
new.q: Sevilla Restaurant, Atakule, Çankaya Caddesi, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Have breakfast at Köy Çayyolu
new.desc: Köy Çayyolu is a village-style breakfast spot with an open-air section and a fireplace room for winter. It appears in 2026 lists of Ankara's best breakfasts.
new.tip: Go at weekends for the full spread; garden seats go first.
new.q: Köy Çayyolu, 2432. Cadde No:55/D, Çayyolu, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Brunch at Jolt Coffee in Ümitköy
new.desc: Jolt Coffee Ümitköy goes beyond coffee with a large breakfast menu and fruity pancakes. It works well for groups.
new.tip: Order a shared breakfast board.
new.q: Jolt Coffee, Ümitköy, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Linger over breakfast at Kruvasante Ümitköy
new.desc: Kruvasante serves breakfast until 14:00, making it a good late-morning stop in Ümitköy. Its pastries and egg dishes are the draw.
new.tip: Go for the croissants and late breakfast.
new.q: Kruvasante, Mutluköy Sitesi, Mutlukent Mahallesi, Ümitköy, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Settle in at Luma Çayyolu
new.desc: Luma Çayyolu is a café and breakfast place listed among Ankara's favourite brunch spots in Çayyolu.
new.tip: Weekend brunch; book ahead.
new.q: Luma Çayyolu, Çayyolu, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Share a table at Rosso da Sofra in Tunalı
new.desc: Rosso da Sofra is a casual Tunalı Hilmi restaurant serving breakfast and Italian-leaning plates. It is popular with locals around Kavaklıdere.
new.tip: Go for weekend brunch.
new.q: Rosso da Sofra, Tunalı Hilmi Caddesi, Kavaklıdere, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Drink at Zula Bar in Kavaklıdere
new.desc: Zula Bar is a Kavaklıdere bar listed among the area's nightlife stops near Tunalı Hilmi.
new.tip: Evenings from Thursday; check opening.
new.q: Zula Bar, Kavaklıdere, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Barhop the Bestekar Sokak strip
new.desc: Bestekar Sokak and neighbouring Arjantin Caddesi are lined with cafés and bars near Kuğulu Park, the heart of Kavaklıdere nightlife.
new.tip: Evenings after 20:00; Thursday to Saturday is busiest.
new.q: Bestekar Sokak, Kavaklıdere, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Hike through the METU Forest
new.desc: ODTÜ Ormanı is a planted forest around Eymir and the METU campus with hiking and mountain-bike trails. It is the largest wooded area near central Ankara.
new.tip: Wear sturdy shoes; trails are well signed.
new.q: ODTÜ Ormanı, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Attend a concert at CSO Ada Ankara
new.desc: CSO Ada Ankara opened on 3 December 2020 as the home of the Presidential Symphony Orchestra. It has a 2,023-seat Ada Salon, a 512-seat Mavi Salon and a historic Tarihi Salon.
new.tip: Book tickets through Biletix or iTicket; dress is smart casual.
new.q: CSO Ada Ankara, Talatpaşa Bulvarı, Anafartalar, Ankara

new.title: Hear the Bilkent Symphony Orchestra
new.desc: Bilkent Concert Hall hosts the Bilkent Symphony Orchestra and visiting artists on the Bilkent campus. It is one of Ankara's main classical venues.
new.tip: Check the programme on the Bilkent site; shuttles run from campus.
new.q: Bilkent Konser Salonu, Bilkent Üniversitesi, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Shop and dine at Panora
new.desc: Panora is a large shopping mall in the Oran district with cinemas, restaurants and an indoor play area. It is a popular all-weather stop.
new.tip: Weekday afternoons are quieter.
new.q: Panora AVM, Oran, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Walk the METU campus lake
new.desc: The campus lake path on ODTÜ is a calm walking and jogging route with views of the forest.
new.tip: Early morning or sunset.
new.q: ODTÜ Gölü, Üniversiteler Mahallesi, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Picnic at Mogan Park, Gölbaşı
new.desc: The lakeside park at Gölbaşı has picnic areas, tea gardens and walking paths beside Mogan Lake.
new.tip: Weekends are crowded; go midweek.
new.q: Mogan Parkı, Gölbaşı, Ankara

new.title: Catch a film at Armada Söğütözü
new.desc: Armada is a large shopping and business complex at Söğütözü with a multiplex cinema, restaurants and shops. A reliable all-weather stop on the Çankaya business strip.
new.tip: Weekday evenings are quiet.
new.q: Armada AVM, Söğütözü, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Browse Next Level in Çukurambar
new.desc: Next Level is a shopping and entertainment centre in Çukurambar with cafés and a cinema, near the MTA museum and Armada.
new.tip: Combine with the MTA museum.
new.q: Next Level AVM, Çukurambar, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Work over coffee at Coffee Lab
new.desc: Coffee Lab is a modern Ankara specialty coffee spot with a communal table, popular with freelancers.
new.tip: Go mid-morning for a quiet seat.
new.q: Coffee Lab, Tunalı Hilmi Caddesi, Kavaklıdere, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Eat fish at Balıkçıköy Fahri
new.desc: Balıkçıköy Fahri is a fish restaurant on Abay Kunanbay Caddesi in Kavaklıdere, recommended in Culture Trip's Ankara restaurant list.
new.tip: Order the fish of the day with raki.
new.q: Balıkçıköy Fahri, Abay Kunanbay Caddesi, Kavaklıdere, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Splurge on steak at Nusr-Et Çankaya
new.desc: Nusr-Et Steakhouse Ankara is a high-end steakhouse in the Gaziosmanpaşa area of Çankaya.
new.tip: Reserve ahead.
new.q: Nusr-Et Steakhouse, Gaziosmanpaşa, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Grab a bagel at Bagel-i Manyak Çayyolu
new.desc: Bagel-i Manyak is a bagel and breakfast cafe in Çayyolu on the yemek.com list of Ankara breakfasts.
new.tip: Order a loaded bagel.
new.q: Bagel-i Manyak, Çayyolu, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Walk Ahmet Taner Kışlalı Park in Çayyolu
new.desc: A neighbourhood park in Çayyolu with paths and playgrounds, a green escape for the western suburbs.
new.tip: Evenings.
new.q: Ahmet Taner Kışlalı Parkı, Çayyolu, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Stroll Cinnah Caddesi from Kuğulu to Atakule
new.desc: Cinnah Caddesi links Kavaklıdere and Çankaya, past embassies, cafés and the entrance to Botanik Park.
new.tip: Evening walk.
new.q: Cinnah Caddesi, Çankaya, Ankara

new.title: Walk the Hacettepe Beytepe campus
new.desc: Hacettepe University's Beytepe campus is a large green campus on the western edge of Çankaya.
new.tip: Weekdays.
new.q: Hacettepe Üniversitesi Beytepe Kampüsü, Çankaya, Ankara
